headline: Topline growth healthy; margin volatility continues

highlights: Per (%) -17/-14/-4 12M Avg Val (INR M) 641 Financials & Valuations (INR b) Y/E March (INR b) FY27E FY28E FY29E Sales 113.5 130.8 151.0 Sales Growth (%) 34.6 15.3 15.4 EBITDA 7.4 8.7 10.4 Margins (%) 6.5 6.7 6.9 Adj.
Festive trading (Oct 1-Nov 11) remained healthy, with revenue growth of 25-26% and SSSG of ~17%.

Management guides for revenue growth of 25%+ in 3Q and 20%+ in 4QFY27, implying 25%+ growth in 2HFY27.  SENCO added 14 net stores in 1HFY27, taking its network to 215 stores (123 COCO and 92 franchise).

Expansion remains focused on North and East, with franchise-led entry into Tier-2/3/4 cities.  Gross margin (adjusted for the INR300mn customs-duty-related inventory gain) contracted sharply by 590bp YoY to 10.8% (vs. est. 15.5%), reflecting aggressive discounting amid competitive intensity, higher old-gold exchange, and channel inventory build-up ahead of the festive season.

It opened another 10 stores between October and mid-November, taking FY27 additions to 24 and already exceeding its full-year target of 18-20 stores.
While management targets a 7.5-7.8% EBITDA margin in 2HFY27, the extent of recovery remains a key monitorable.
